name: three_stage_control.py
mathematical_scope: Constructs block diagonal copies of [[1,1],[1,2]]. Every contiguous strict off-diagonal cut has rank 0 or 1; each even/odd half-submatrix is a nonzero scalar identity over the imported odd field, hence full half-rank.
input_and_guard_coverage: L6 only asserts evenness. n=0 and negative even n reach max(empty); odd checks disappear with optimization. Characteristic 2 would destroy the 2I parity block, so the dependency field matters.
costs: Dense n-by-n storage O(n²); O(n) dense rank computations give conservative O(n⁴) field-operation upper bound, plus four half-rank computations. Structural proof itself is simpler.
test_evidence: Companion tests cover n=8,16,32,64; no source was executed.
acceptance_boundary: Accept the explicit odd-characteristic block counterexample analytically; it refutes a naive inference, not all three-stage Fourier feasibility.
findings: L6: add an integer even n>=2 contract. L22–24 assertions and maxima are not robust input validation.
